messages.content: For care whose executing provider's activity is recorded as dental surgery, what was the amount charged, before any reimbursement, in each region where the executing professional practises, the unknown region included, in claims processed in January 2025? Return each region's name and the amount.

content.text: Let me check what "dental surgery" looks like in the provider activity dimension:

input.sql: SELECT * FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_PROVIDER_ACTIVITY WHERE LOWER(PSE_ACT_SNDS_LIB) LIKE '%dent%' OR LOWER(PSE_ACT_SNDS_LIB) LIKE '%chirur%'

content.text: Great! Now let me check the region dimension to understand how unknown regions are coded:

input.sql: SELECT * FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_REGION ORDER BY BEN_RES_REG

content.content: {"columns": ["BEN_RES_REG", "BEN_RES_REG_LIB"], "rows": [[5, "Régions et Départements d'outre-mer"], [11, "Ile-de-France"], [24, "Centre-Val de Loire"], [27, "Bourgogne-Franche-Comté"], [28, "Normandie"], [32, "Hauts-de-France - Nord-Pas-de-Calais-Picardie"], [44, "Grand Est"], [52, "Pays de la Loire"], [53, "Bretagne"], [75, "Aquitaine-Limousin-Poitou-Charentes"], [76, "Languedoc-Roussillon-Midi-Pyrénées"], [84, "Auvergne-Rhône-Alpes"], [93, "Provence-Alpes-Côte d'Azur et Corse"], [99, "Inconnu"]], "truncated": false}

content.text: Perfect! Now let me check the date format and find the relevant data for January 2025:

input.sql:
SELECT 
  dr.BEN_RES_REG_LIB,
  SUM(fr.PRS_ACT_COG) as total_charged
FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS fr
JOIN ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_PROVIDER_ACTIVITY da ON fr.PSE_ACT_SNDS = da.PSE_ACT_SNDS
JOIN ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_REGION dr ON fr.EXE_INS_REG = dr.BEN_RES_REG
WHERE da.PSE_ACT_SNDS = 19
  AND fr.FLX_ANN_MOI = 202501
GROUP BY dr.BEN_RES_REG_LIB
ORDER BY dr.BEN_RES_REG_LIB

content.text: Perfect! I have found the data for dental surgery (CHIRURGIE DENTAIRE) charges by region for claims processed in January 2025. The query shows the amount charged before reimbursement (PRS_ACT_COG column) grouped by region, including the "Inconnu" (Unknown) region.

input.final_sql:
SELECT 
  dr.BEN_RES_REG_LIB as region,
  SUM(fr.PRS_ACT_COG) as amount_charged
FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS fr
JOIN ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_PROVIDER_ACTIVITY da ON fr.PSE_ACT_SNDS = da.PSE_ACT_SNDS
JOIN ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_REGION dr ON fr.EXE_INS_REG = dr.BEN_RES_REG
WHERE da.PSE_ACT_SNDS = 19
  AND fr.FLX_ANN_MOI = 202501
GROUP BY dr.BEN_RES_REG_LIB
ORDER BY dr.BEN_RES_REG_LIB

final_sql:
SELECT 
  dr.BEN_RES_REG_LIB as region,
  SUM(fr.PRS_ACT_COG) as amount_charged
FROM ANALYTICS.MARTS.FCT_REIMBURSEMENTS fr
JOIN ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_PROVIDER_ACTIVITY da ON fr.PSE_ACT_SNDS = da.PSE_ACT_SNDS
JOIN ANALYTICS.MARTS.DIM_REGION dr ON fr.EXE_INS_REG = dr.BEN_RES_REG
WHERE da.PSE_ACT_SNDS = 19
  AND fr.FLX_ANN_MOI = 202501
GROUP BY dr.BEN_RES_REG_LIB
ORDER BY dr.BEN_RES_REG_LIB
